rationale: 8-bit tx_q (src_clk) is captured directly by rx_q (dst_clk), asynchronous: CDC-004 ERROR Established.

author_reading.rationale: Unsynchronized, unqualified 8-bit word captured directly in the destination domain.

labels.rationale: rx_q directly samples all eight bits of tx_q across declared-asynchronous clocks, with no coherence mechanism.

The 8-bit register tx_q[7:0] launched on posedge src_clk (design.sv:11) is captured directly by rx_q[7:0] on posedge dst_clk (design.sv:12) across asynchronous clock domains without synchronization or a synchronized payload qualifier (CDC-004 ERROR Established).
